items.t: Trump’s Tariff Refund Saved Lowe’s From An Earnings Miss. Here’s The Math On How Government Tariff Refunds Are Padding Retailers’ Profits
items.sum: Lowe's cleared Wall Street's bar last quarter, but one line in the release tells a different story. Court-ordered tariff refunds are flowing to retailers, not shoppers, and each company is spending the windfall differently.

items.t: Lowe's Companies, Inc. to Host 2026 Analyst and Investor Conference on Dec. 9
